tpl.tpl_assessment.name: Assessment: no speed bonus, no leaderboard
tpl.tpl_assessment.desc: Calm, fair testing: 30 s, speed does not affect points, questions and answers are shuffled, no leaderboard or correct answers during the game.

tpl.tpl_training.name: Corporate training: 45 s, explanations, late joining

tpl.tpl_cyber.desc: Scenario questions: an explanation follows each answer and options are shuffled so players cannot guess by position.

usage.title: Cloudflare Free plan usage
usage.intro: How much of the free Cloudflare allowances was used today, whether the next game fits, and what different plans would cost. Every number below is one of three kinds; do not mix them up.
usage.kind.estimate.help: A forecast from the application's model. Not a measurement and not a Cloudflare bill.
usage.kind.measured.help: Counters the application keeps about itself. A lower bound: Cloudflare sees more (page and API requests are not counted one by one).
usage.kind.official.help: Figures from the Cloudflare dashboard that you type in yourself. Only these are official.
usage.limitsDate: Limits come from config/cloudflare-limits.json, last verified
usage.noAlerts: No resource has reached a threshold today.
usage.measuredNote: "Measured" covers finished games and image uploads; a game that is still running is added when it ends. For safety compare with the Cloudflare dashboard and enter its figures below: alerts use the larger of the two.
usage.cpuNote: CPU time per invocation (10 ms) is not measured by the application: it is a per-call limit, not a daily sum. Check it on a real Cloudflare account under load.
usage.off.title: Official figures from the Cloudflare dashboard
usage.off.help: Open the Cloudflare dashboard → Workers & Pages → your app → Metrics (Durable Objects and D1 have their own sections), find the day's value and type it here. No API token is needed.
usage.off.badValue: Enter a number, zero or more.
usage.calc.title: Calculator
usage.calc.help: Enter the expected use to see what it needs and how much of the free allowance remains. "Worst case": 120 participants, at least 50 questions and 90 minutes, three reconnects per participant, 3 messages per question.
usage.calc.bottleneck: The resource that runs out first
usage.calc.gamesPerDay: games of this size per day
usage.calc.note: A model built on local measurements; not yet checked on a real Cloudflare account. Limits are daily; "per month" is for reference. Storage accumulates over the retention period.
usage.th.title: Alert thresholds
usage.th.help: The percentage of the daily limit at which each level appears. The "quota reached" level (100 %) is fixed.
usage.pre.title: A Cloudflare limit is close
usage.pre.intro: By estimate, this game would push these resources toward their daily limit. Cloudflare does not charge: once a limit is used up, operations simply stop working until 00:00 UTC.
usage.pre.fit: More games like this that fit today
usage.pre.safeHelp: At most {n} participants and no extras. This lowers the load but does not remove the limit.
usage.pre.noPaid: No paid Cloudflare features are switched on and the plan is not changed.
err.invalid_thresholds: Thresholds must rise: whole numbers from 1 to 99 %.
